sources.snippet: ResNet 18 is image classification model pre-trained on ImageNet dataset. This is PyTorch* implementation based on architecture described in paper “Deep Residual Learning for Image Recognition” in TorchVision package (see here). The model input is a blob that consists of a single image of 1, 3, 224, 224 in RGB order.
